incoming.name: Bryce Canyon National Park
incoming.excerpt: Most bird species migrate to warmer regions in winter, but jays, ravens, nuthatches, eagles, and owls stay.

incoming.name: Mount Rushmore
incoming.excerpt: Smaller birds, including songbirds, nuthatches, and woodpeckers, inhabit the surrounding pine forests.
